title: Accept header preference order
summary: Parse an HTTP Accept header (q-values, parameters, wildcards) and return its acceptable media ranges in order of preference.
notes: No standard library of Node, Python, Ruby or Go parses an Accept header into a preference list, so there is no builtin entry. Wildcard ranges always rank below more specific ones by q, because goautoneg's comparator puts a wildcard after a concrete range whatever the q values.
